candidates.title: SceneRig: An Agentic System for Simulation-Ready 3D Scene Reconstruction from Single Images
candidates.discovered_from: arXiv submitted sweep and official project page
candidates.why_candidate: Physics-validated single-image reconstruction with matched real/sim policy-outcome and trajectory-replay tests.

candidates.title: NeoWorld-3: From Pixels to Code-Defined Physical Worlds
candidates.why_candidate: Executable program representation and physical validation from articulated objects to scenes.

candidates.title: InfiniDream: Open-Ended Photorealistic 3D Worlds Through Procedural Generation
candidates.discovered_from: arXiv submitted sweep and project page
candidates.why_candidate: Open-ended procedural assets and large worlds beyond predefined factories.

candidates.title: UniFlowWAM: A Unified World-Action Model with Visual Semantics and 4D Geometry
candidates.discovered_from: arXiv submitted sweep and official project page
candidates.why_candidate: Joint vision, action and scene-flow training with matched policy ablation and real-robot results.

candidates.title: PhysiCalWorld: In-Context Physics Calibration for World Models
candidates.discovered_from: arXiv submitted sweep and official project page
candidates.why_candidate: Calibrates hidden mass, damping, friction and drag from exploratory interaction without fine-tuning.

candidates.title: Sensorimotor Alignment: A Platonic Proxy for Embodied Policy Success
candidates.discovered_from: arXiv submitted sweep and official code/project page
candidates.why_candidate: Training-free offline metric predicts closed-loop success across policy families and can screen VLM backbones.

candidates.title: PhysTrace: Interpretable Temporal Evaluation of Physical Consistency in Video Generative Models
candidates.discovered_from: arXiv submitted sweep and official code release
candidates.why_candidate: Temporally localizes physical violations and releases IntPhys2-Timing plus a runnable evaluator.

candidates.title: RoboJudge: Multimodal Language Models as Judges for Embodied Video Generation
candidates.discovered_from: arXiv submitted sweep and official project/release surfaces
candidates.why_candidate: Human-annotated embodied-video judge benchmark, training set and specialized evaluator.

candidates.title: AutoPhyX: Automatic Text-Condition Physics Property Generation
candidates.discovered_from: arXiv submitted sweep and official project page
candidates.why_candidate: Text-conditioned spatial physical-property fields across meshes, points, Gaussians and NeRFs.

candidates.title: DRILL: Training World Models to Improve Policies, Not Predict Pixels
candidates.why_candidate: Optimizes world models for downstream policy return rather than pixel prediction.

candidates.title: PVBench: Quantifying Physical Plausibility in Video Generation with Object-Level Physical Measurements
candidates.why_candidate: Object-level physical measurements across geometry, material, kinematics and conservation laws.
